manifest_metadata.protocol: OptiFilter Internal Empirical Validation Protocol — v2 (Research-Ready)
manifest_metadata.drishti_gs_note: Uses only the official Drishti-GS training set (50 images with annotated GT). The physical test set (51 images) is held entirely separate and NOT used for any metric reporting. Internal splits are: 35 development (for hyperparameter exploration) and 15 held-out (for unbiased final evaluation). Split assigned by seed-42 stratified selection preserving the original non-contiguous numbering.
manifest_metadata.drive_note: Uses all 20 training images with expert vessel GT. 15 development / 5 held-out under seed 42.

Drishti-GS._comment: All 50 official Drishti-GS training images. Split 35 dev / 15 held-out by seed 42.
